==Quest information==
===Objectives===
* Defeat the [[Iron Forgeman]] in [[Sorrow's Furnace]] in [[Hard Mode]].

===Reward===
* 2,025 [[experience]]
* 2,005 [[gold]]
* [[Miniature Longhair Yeti]]
:{{gray|This item cannot be traded or sold.}}

==Dialogue==
===Initial dialogue===
;Merrise, Sworn to Seas
:''"Your traveling companions are a unique part of any journey, wouldn't you say? Even something as small as a toy or pet can bring memories alongside it."''
:''"In exchange for a show of your heroism, I can offer a particularly rare toy to take with you."''
{{offer dialogue
|accept = Sounds difficult, but there's no road I can't walk.
|decline = I've got enough friends.
|ask = Take as long as you like on my offer. The journey to the heights of heroism is surely an experience worth the struggle. }}
=== Reward dialogue ===
; Merrise, Sworn to Seas
: ''"I hope you enjoyed the hurdles you had to pass to accomplish my task. And even if it was a struggle, let this reward bring you a smile."''

==Notes==
* Unlike other festival event quests, the Miniature Companion quests are permanent and not only available during the associated event.
* [[The Final Assault]] is needed to encounter the Iron Forgeman. 
** Since this quest is also [[Black_Moa_Chick#Incubation_details|required]] to acquire the [[Black Moa Chick]], consider bringing a complete [[Incubator Kit]] if you intend to get both miniatures.

== Trivia ==
* The rewards are a reference to the year ''[[Guild Wars Prophecies]]'' was released (2005) and the year of the 20th birthday (2025).
